newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 UP 4 PCT, M2 RISES 6 PCT AUG30-SEPT20.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 UP 4 PCT, M2 RISES 6 PCT AUG30-SEPT20.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply rose to 147.8 billion levs on September 20 from 142.1 billion levs on August 30 and M2 increased to 832.3 billion levs from 786.2 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.

Total broad money rose 6.08 percent to 866.6 billion levs as lev-denominated broad money inched up 0.04 percent to 482.2 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money increased 14.78 percent to 384.4 billion levs.
Hard currency-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals totalled $ 1.537 billion on September 20, down $3 million from August 30.
Lev-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals fell to 275.0 billion levs on September 20 from 279.0 billion levs on August 30. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
